pages.text: $(bold)Lignite$(): soft coal. Y -4 to 32. Fuel.$(br2)$(bold)Galena$() (dark grey): lead $(bold)and$() silver, both from every block. Y -16 to 32. Lead is musket and cannon shot and the Supplementaries cannonball. Silver makes electrum; clerics buy it.

$(bold)Gold$(): gold. Y -64 to 32, dry land only (desert, badlands, savanna). Create's precision mechanisms, electrum, golden food.$(br2)$(bold)Platinum$(): platinum. Y -25 to 19. Platinum sheets build a precision mechanism in three steps instead of five. An expert cleric pays two emeralds an ingot.

$(bold)Lapis$(): lapis. Y -64 to 64.$(br2)$(bold)Azurite$() (dark blue): copper, the deep kind. Y -49 to 13.$(br)$(bold)Cinnabar$() (red): redstone. Y -60 to 15. Create's rose quartz, electron tubes, every contraption with a switch.
